interventions.hypothesis: Control/instruction fields must be consumed by typed semantics rather than mapped as payload or rejected as unresolved.
Explicit conflict semantics in the request must not be degraded to needs_clarification or a contradictory action.
Explicit requested update columns define a closed update set and must survive planning/materialization without omission or relationship-column expansion.
interventions.stage1_evidence: 4 executed-but-wrong update-column omission cases plus latent relationship-column expansion cases
